Create Person.description: Registers a new person (e.g. a patient) under a household or health facility.

Create Place.description: Creates a place in the CHT hierarchy, such as a household under a CHW area.

Create Report.description: Submits a JSON form report (e.g. a pregnancy registration) to CHT.

Update Person.description: Updates an existing person's details, e.g. a new phone number.

Create User.description: Creates a CHT user account for a community health worker linked to their place.

Export Reports.description: Exports submitted reports for selected forms within a date range, e.g. to push to DHIS2.

Export Contacts.description: Exports contacts matching a free-text search.

List Persons By Type.description: Lists persons of a given contact type, page by page.

Get Person By ID.description: Fetches a single person record by its uuid.
Get Person By ID.code:
// Fetch a person by uuid.
get(`/api/v1/person/${$.data.personId}`);

Find Contacts By Phone.description: Finds contacts registered with a given phone number.

Get Targets.description: Fetches CHW performance targets, e.g. for programme dashboards.
